overrides.contains: no writer of this work is to be found on earth
overrides.tts_text: But, after all, no writer of this work is to be found on earth.
overrides.direction: a poet with a finished masterpiece and no one to write it down

overrides.contains: Thou hast called thy present work a poem

split.text: And when he had been saluted, and was seated, Vyasa addressed him thus,
O guide of the Ganas! be thou the writer of the Bharata which I have formed in my imagination, and which I am about to repeat.
split.speaker: vyasa
split.direction: a respectful request to a god

overrides.contains: provided my pen do not for a moment cease

split.text: I will become the writer of thy work, provided my pen do not for a moment cease writing.
split.speaker: ganesa
split.direction: a playful divine condition, a smile in the voice

split.text: And Vyasa said unto that divinity,
split.speaker: sauti

split.text: Wherever there be anything thou dost not comprehend, cease to continue writing.
split.speaker: vyasa

overrides.tts_text: Ganesa having signified his assent, by repeating the word Om, proceeded to write; and Vyasa began; and by way of diversion, he knit the knots of composition exceeding close; by doing which, he dictated this work according to his engagement.
